template.p: The Architecture Firm industry package helps architecture practices manage enquiries, phase fees, site meetings, client reports and invoicing with the CRM, Sales, Project, Timesheets, Planning and Documents apps.

With demo data, use Administrator to follow the firm owner's workflow. Administrator leads Architecture Enquiries, owns the sample opportunities and quotations, manages the projects, and can find the main project tasks in My Tasks. Michael Demo shows how to delegate design and planning.

For a real firm, assign your staff to the Architecture enquiry coordinator, Architecture project lead, and Architecture designer roles. Assign the relevant employee resources to the Architect planning role and review their calendars.

Review the service catalogue, prices, taxes and quotation wording before sending proposals. The Construction-cost Fee Contract template starts with four phase allocations of 20%, 20%, 30% and 30%. These are editable examples, not a prescribed fee schedule.

The website project form accepts private homeowners and organizations. It records the site address or area, requested service, indicative works budget and currency, desired start date, and project brief. Website defaults route enquiries to Architecture Enquiries without a hidden Administrator assignment.

For the Architecture Enquiries team, a new enquiry creates a first-contact call due in one calendar day for the Architecture enquiry coordinator role. Entering Needs Analysis creates a brief-review activity due in ten calendar days for the opportunity salesperson. Sending a quotation assigned to the team schedules a quotation follow-up in 15 calendar days for the quotation salesperson.

The brief, site address, indicative works budget and requested start date appear on the generated project through the linked sales order. Treat the requested start date as client input; set the actual project schedule and select its Associated Location contact separately for the map.

Create a quotation from the opportunity, enable Construction-cost fees, and use Tax Excl. pricing. Enter a positive Construction cost excl. VAT in the quotation currency and a positive Fixed fee rate (%). A rate of 5 means 5%. Apply the Construction-cost Fee Contract template and review each Phase allocation (%). Allocations must total 100% before sending or confirming the quotation. The pricing mode is locked on the confirmed order.

Total architecture fee = construction cost excluding VAT × fixed fee rate / 100. Each phase receives its agreed percentage of that total. The normal phase quantity is one; if another positive quantity is agreed, its unit price is adjusted to preserve the phase fee. Phase lines use milestone billing without a second line discount.

The fixed contractual rate remains unchanged when the construction-cost base changes. The rate is editable on a quotation and read-only on the confirmed order form. Updating the construction cost or a phase allocation reprices the sales-order phases; it does not rewrite posted invoice lines. Unlock a locked order through the normal Sales workflow before a revision.

Keep independently agreed hourly work separate. Studies and Additional Design Work invoice recorded time against their linked tasks. Select the existing project for a standalone Additional Design Work quote. Agree the rate and limit before work begins. Record separately chargeable mileage through Expenses against the sales order and avoid entering the same trip twice. Use standard Sales down payments when a deposit is agreed, and review their deduction on the final invoice.

Set Invoice Address on the quotation to the person or company that should receive the invoice. Record the client who commissioned the work as Project owner on the project. Check the invoice address and taxes when another entity pays for the work.

Confirm the Construction-cost Fee Contract quotation to create a project from Architecture by Phase from Sales, with a task and a billing milestone for each phase sold. The four stages are Schematic Design, Preliminary Design, Detailed Design and Construction Administration. Use the task status to track progress within each phase. Remove the Open Tasks filter to see completed phases.

In the Project app, start from the Architecture by Phase template to create a board with one task per phase before there is a sales order. Use the Full Mission quotation for a detailed workflow with separate preparation, review and approval subtasks.

Launch Architecture project kickoff on the project with an agreed reference date and responsible person. Confirm the site contact, scope, team, schedule and budget hours. Define when each billing milestone can be marked as reached and record the client’s acceptance on the phase task.

img.alt: Project links to tasks, timesheets, documents, sales and invoicing.

template.p: Client review contact identifies whose feedback is needed. Launch Architecture phase review on the phase task, choose its reference date and responsible person, and review the scheduled activities. Record written acceptance or requested changes on the phase task or its client-review subtask.

Keep working drawings and coordination files in the project folders. Place agreed released revisions in Client Deliverables and share them deliberately with the named client recipients. Initial folders disable link access; the firm can adjust internal permissions and sharing using the Documents app. Sample floor plans belong only to a fictional demo project, not the reusable project folder.

Mark the linked billing milestone as reached only after the contractual completion condition is met. Then review invoiceable phases, hourly extras and expenses in the Sales app before creating an invoice.
template.h2: Log site meetings and share minutes
template.p: Open Project Contacts on the project and set the Project owner (maître d’ouvrage), the Works coordinator (maître d’œuvre) and other contacts with their trade or role. For projects started without an architecture template, enable Architecture follow-up in project settings. Use the normal sharing controls when someone needs project access.

ol.li: In the project’s Updates, create an update and set Report type to Site meeting.
Use the Attendance tab to add the expected participants from Project Contacts and include any guests. Enter each person’s role and mark them present, absent, or excused.
In Description, record decisions, follow-up actions and due dates. Use Print report to view the PDF or select a Report recipient and use Send report to review the email and attachment before sending.

template.p: When the agreed construction-cost estimate or actual cost changes, update Construction cost excl. VAT on the confirmed fee order. Phase prices recalculate from the same fixed fee rate and allocations. Preserve the agreed basis and supporting decision in the order discussion.

Creating the next customer invoice calculates one fee adjustment per previously invoiced phase that has a shortfall or overcharge. It compares the current untaxed phase value for the net quantity previously invoiced with signed original invoices and previous adjustments. Credit notes subtract from that history; cancelled invoices are excluded. Original invoice prices remain the historical evidence.

Existing drafts refresh only when you select Recalculate fee adjustments on the draft invoice. This also refreshes its ordinary fee phase prices, leaving unrelated hourly lines unchanged. Generated adjustment lines are rebuilt rather than appended again. If no adjustment remains, an adjustment-only draft becomes empty and can be cancelled. The optional Fee phase corrected column identifies the phase being corrected.

Use Create fee adjustment invoice on a confirmed fee order when only a historical catch-up is due and no new phase is invoiceable. A negative net result becomes a draft credit note. Use the Fee Invoices button on the sales order to reopen its fee invoices and credit notes, including adjustment-only drafts. Reversal credit notes retain their original phase links.

Complete or cancel another open draft invoice or credit note for the same fee order before creating or recalculating the next one. Fee history must use the same company and currency as the order, and each original invoice line must identify one phase. These rules keep the correction allocation unambiguous.
template.h2: Plan work and read the progress report
template.p: Use the Architect planning role and morning or afternoon shift templates to reserve staff time. Review working calendars and leave before scheduling a draft shift. Fee phase quantities represent fees, not staffing hours; set task budget hours and plan the actual work separately.

The Progress Report is available to Sales users and administrators, subject to their normal record access. It lists confirmed sales orders and excludes reusable project templates. Select the relevant project, order or Currency before reviewing totals. Totals remain blank when the list contains multiple currencies.

The Progress Report shows monetary amounts excluding VAT. Posted amounts include fee adjustments, which carry no milestone quantity. To Invoice Quantity uses Odoo’s normal billing policy and accounts for draft invoice quantities. Unbilled excl. VAT (before drafts) shows the amount eligible under that policy after posted invoices and credit notes. Open the sales order’s invoices to review draft amounts.

Keep a copy of the accepted quotation for the original fee. At month end, review the linked sales orders for current contract values and use Invoices or Fee Invoices to review posted and draft documents. Subtract credit notes from the totals and list unapproved quotes separately.

Create a project update with Monthly financial update as its Report type. In the Financial Snapshot tab, enter the dated figures, currency, and tax basis. Remaining after drafts is the current contract value minus net posted and draft amounts, including future phases. Use a new update each month to preserve earlier figures.
Billing access is required to view, edit, print, or share the figures. Use Print report to save a copy, or select a Report recipient and choose Send report to review the email and attachment.

These examples are available when demo data is loaded. Dates are relative to the import date. Sales and billing examples use the company's currency. Indicative works budgets submitted by prospects include their own currency in the brief.
Hover over the question mark beside Construction cost excl. VAT on a fee order or Report type on a project update for guidance while completing the form.

ol.li: In the CRM app, open Linden Apartment — new enquiry in Architecture Enquiries. Use the scheduled call to qualify Camille's request. Complete the call and move the opportunity to Needs Analysis to see the brief-review activity. Open Canal House — extension consultation for an example with a booked consultation and an existing client contact.

From Atelier North — office fit-out proposal, open its quotation, Atelier North Fit-Out. Review the proposal and its follow-up activity. The demo marks the quotation as sent through the Sales app workflow without delivering an email. Review scope and site access before confirming the quotation.

Open the Courtyard Studio order in the Sales app. Its posted invoice includes four feasibility hours at 200 per hour, two accepted renderings at 100 each, and 60 km at 0.90 per km. The untaxed subtotal is 1,054. Trace the quantities to the feasibility task's timesheet, the rendering milestone, and the posted mileage expense linked to the order. The permit milestone is still open. For an order with recorded hours still available to invoice, open Riverside House and review the outstanding declaration activity before releasing the report.

Open Cedar Works in the Project app, then open the phase in Client Review. Compare the sample floor plans with the brief and record Joanna's decision on the review subtask. The draft planning block reserves time for revisions. Next, open Cedar Works Technical Package. Its Architecture Services pricelist sets the Additional Design Work rate at 110 per hour. The 1.5-hour timesheet makes 165 available to invoice before tax while the phase milestone is open. After acceptance and release, mark the milestone as reached.

Open Willow Farm Renovation in the Sales app and compare its two invoices. The posted invoice bills the first two phases for 6,000 at the original construction cost of 300,000 and fixed 5% fee. The agreed construction cost rises to 350,000, bringing the total fee to 17,500. The draft bills 5,250 for Detailed Design plus two adjustments of 500 for the earlier phases. Its total is 6,250 excluding VAT, with taxes omitted for the example. Use Recalculate fee adjustments to review the current draft against the posted amounts.

In Willow Farm project updates, open the site meeting and the monthly financial update. The attendance list records an absent electrical contractor. The manually entered snapshot shows the 15,000 original quote, 17,500 current contract, 6,000 invoiced, 6,250 in draft, and 5,250 remaining. The 500 lighting quote awaits approval. Marie José is the project owner and Willow Farm Properties is the invoice address.
